messages.subject: Project Mosaic - contract mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Our mark-up of the contract is attached (changes tracked). The principal points are: contract rate moved to the Law Society rate (2% over Clydesford base) from 4%; service charge retention up to £25,000 with a 10 working day release; conduct/benefit of the Unit 4 review to pass to the buyer and your client not to settle it pre-completion without consent; and the VAT-default payment window extended to twenty working days. Most of the rest is house style.

Grateful for a quick turn given the exchange timetable.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate — Real Estate
Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Reviewed with the client. We can live with the £25,000 retention and the contract rate change. On the Unit 4 review, our client will agree not to conclude it before completion without consent, but wants the assistance obligation to be reasonable and at the buyer's cost - I've adjusted the wording, otherwise your draft is largely agreed. We should be in a position to agree the engrossment this week.

Alistair
